_comment: USSD templates live here as DATA. To add a wallet or fix a carrier code, edit this file only -- no Dart code names a specific wallet. Placeholders are {phone} and {amount}. {phone} is substituted with the 10-digit local form (0599123456). NEVER add a PIN placeholder: the PIN is entered in the carrier's own USSD prompt, never in the dialed string.

smsConfirmation._comment: Matched against the SMS notification after Arabic-Indic digits are folded to ASCII and whitespace is collapsed. Both named groups are required. Only SENT messages may match: a receive SMS ("استلمت مبلغ ...") must never confirm a payment.
"لصديق ل " is a send; "لصديق من " is a receive and must not match.
sentPatterns: حركة دفع لصديق ل (?<party>.+?) بمبلغ (?<amount>[0-9.,]+) شيكل
